Hello Alvin, 
Thank you for clarifying. 
If you will be tracking a relatively fixed fleet of vessels, then the VesselsList method would be more 
appropriate to your needs. 
The VesselsList method of our API allows you to fetch the AIS 
dataset (optionally Voyage and/or Master dataset at extra cost) for a predefined list of vessels (specified 
by IMO or MMSI number) at a regular interval.  
Each API response returns the last updated datasets for all listed vessels in XML or JSON format.  
The service is provided on a subscription basis and the subscription fee depends on the number of 
vessels, the query interval (every 1 minute, 1 hour, etc.), and the included datasets (AIS, Voyage, 
Master).  
A subscription lasts 1-month, unless prepaid for a longer period, or otherwise specified. At the end of 
the subscription period, access to the service is automatically revoked, unless you wish to continue using 
the service. 
Here is an example of how the service works:  
• you specify a fixed list of 20 vessels (by IMO or MMSI number) 
• you want access to the data every 1 hour  
• when you run the query, the API will provide you the last updated position for all 20 vessels in 
XML/JSON format 
You will be able to update your vessel list in two ways - manually using our ListManager interface or 
automatically using the ListManager API method.  
The number of changes allowed in a calendar month is limited to the maximum number of vessels in 
your fleet. 
For example, if you have a fleet of 100 ships, you are allowed to change the whole fleet once every 
month, or make 100 individual changes/month. Each month, the allowed changes reset. 
 
Here is sample pricing for the AIS dataset fetched at different query intervals and for number of vessels 
Query interval Number of vessels Cost per month 
1-hour 200 650€ 
2-hours 200 620€ 
4-hours 200 570€

6-hours 200 530€ 
12-hours 200 505€ 
24-hours 200 480€ 
Query interval Number of vessels Cost per month 
1-hour 100 460€ 
2-hours 100 435€ 
4-hours 100 400€ 
6-hours 100 375€ 
12-hours 100 355€ 
24-hours 100 335€ 
Better pricing can be offered if you subscribe (prepay) to the service for a longer period (3, 6 or 12 
months).  
Note that the query interval represents how often you can call the API service. The actual vessel 
position update rate may vary due to various factors (e.g. region and AIS sources availability) and 
cannot be guaranteed.  
 
if you can also show extra cost of the master data and other price 
The cost to include each of the additional Master or Voyage datasets is 15% on top of the price. This 
means if you wish to include both datasets, you would need to pay 30% more.  
 
You mentioned that list of vessels API specified by IMO or MMSI, if I only have name of the vessels and 
port destination is it possible to query using your API, how it works? 
Our API allows querying only using IMO/MMSI numbers. Querying via name is not available with any of 
our API methods.  
You can search by name on our website and this way you can obtain the MMSI/IMO numbers of vessels. 
However, this process is manual and can take some time.
